_doc: Every non-data number the TPP demo uses. Leaves are {value, unit, rationale, source} as in examples/mpo_v2/params.json, so tpp.legacy.Params reads both. DATA comes from the user's two workbooks; everything here is an ASSUMPTION until replaced by ADIC figures. The regime / factor / owner-draw model is read from examples/mpo_v2/params.json (overridden where noted).

total_nav_bn.rationale: Whole-fund NAV. The fund file holds only the externally managed fund and co-investment book; the gap is the internally managed sleeves below.

max_stale_months.rationale: A row counts as a live holding when its latest performance date is within this window of the file's as-of date. Older marks are legacy rows, reported on the Data page.

include_legacy_rows.rationale: Rows last marked before the staleness window (pre-restructuring stakes, old deposits, futures and loans) are excluded unless the user confirms they are still held.

min_live_nav_usd.rationale: Rows below this NAV and with no unfunded commitment are fully realized and carry no exposure.

gap_split.rationale: Sleeves priced in the ER file but absent from the fund file: Global Equities Division (DM, EM, global), Global Agg, Treasury, Cash and the multi-asset overlay's capital. Working split until the Balance Sheet group enters actual balances.
gap_split.source: Assumption; prior working allocation v2 (long-only 20%, Treasury 8.5% of $177bn)

sofr.rationale: Financing base rate, held flat over the horizon (rate shocks are a stress, not a path).

revolver_signed_bn.rationale: Committed revolving facility (contingent liquidity, last in the waterfall before forced sales).

revolver_drawn0_bn.rationale: Drawn balance today; enter the actual figure.

revolver_undrawn_fee.rationale: Commitment fee on the undrawn amount.

revolver_avail.unit: share drawable by market state [BEN, DRT, STR]
revolver_avail.rationale: Banks cut availability in a crisis.

term_debt0_bn.rationale: Existing term debt; enter the actual figure.

navf_ltv_max.rationale: Maximum loan-to-value on the private pledge pool.

navf_ltv_stress.rationale: LTV covenant in a crisis; a breach forces repayment from the reserve.

beta0_bn.rationale: Synthetic equity beta held today (the MAO sleeves carry the existing overlay strategies). LEVER adds to it.

beta_max_bn.rationale: Upper bound for the LEVER lever (gross overlay cap applies too).
beta_max_bn.source: Assumption; prototype gross overlay cap 30% of NAV

beta_fin_spread.unit: per year over SOFR by state

im_rate.rationale: Initial margin posted from the reserve (encumbered).

mao_returns_are_excess.rationale: The ER file's Internal MAO base (3.3%) is below cash (3.8%), so the MAO figures are read as excess return over cash on allocated capital. Set false to read them as total returns.

mode.rationale: rule = the prototype's oil-linked draw (5-10% of opening NAV, smoothed, higher when Brent is weak); fixed_rate = a flat rate.
mode.source: User 2026-10-18 (5-10%, higher when oil is weak); examples/mpo_v2 owner_draw

floor_hard.rationale: Hard liquidity floor; below it the waterfall sells liquid assets.

floor_target.rationale: Target reserve restored at year ends from surplus.

waterfall.rationale: Liquid sales after the reserve, then the revolver, then forced secondary sales of private holdings (a red event).
waterfall.source: Liquidity policy default; editable by the Liquidity group

hf_quarterly_liquidity.unit: share of HF NAV redeemable per quarter by state
hf_quarterly_liquidity.rationale: Quarterly dealing with gates in stress.
hf_quarterly_liquidity.source: examples/mpo_v2 trading.redeem_phi (100/95/66% within 12 months), made quarterly

forced_sale_extra_discount.rationale: Distressed-seller discount on top of the market bid.

red_event_threshold_bn.rationale: A forced private sale above this is a red event.

enabled.rationale: Private Equity has decided to sell $20bn of its overall exposure over the next three years, underperforming assets first.

years.rationale: Tranches at the start of each program year (quarters 0, 4, 8).

basis.rationale: 'Overall exposure' read as NAV + unfunded commitment; set to nav to count NAV only.
basis.source: Interpretation of the user's wording; switchable

selection.rationale: Underperformers first: lowest forward return against the hold value, then the actual-vs-underwritten shortfall.

departments.rationale: Buyout EU, Buyout US and Venture Capital, funds and co-investments.

start_in_drought.rationale: DPI has been falling: today's exit window is a drought (distributions at 0.47x normal).

prolonged_drought_persistence.unit: quarterly probability of staying in drought

er_return_type.rationale: ER figures read as expected compound annual returns; the simulator matches their log mean.

uw_bias_prior_pp.rationale: Prior underwriting optimism (underwritten minus realized IRR) where a bucket has few mature holdings.

credibility_constant.rationale: Buhlmann credibility Z = n / (n + k) for the bucket's measured underwriting bias.

mature_age.rationale: A holding is mature (its since-inception IRR is informative about underwriting accuracy) at this age or with DPI >= mature_dpi.

actual_min_age.rationale: Below this age the since-inception IRR is J-curve noise and is not used.

tilt_cap_pp.rationale: Cap on any holding-level tilt from the strategy return.

clip.rationale: Sanity bounds on any forward return.

horizon_years.rationale: Horizon of the utility certainty equivalent.

bucket_overrides.unit: loadings on [equity, credit, rates, oil, exit, vol]; annual idiosyncratic vol
bucket_overrides.rationale: Hedge funds are not riskless. A diversified institutional program carries an equity beta of about 0.4 (higher in sell-offs), credit and short-volatility exposure (crowding and deleveraging), and manager-specific risk. With these loadings the program runs about 9% annual volatility in the model (equities about 21%) with an equity beta of about 0.4, and loses about 23% in the worst 5% of year-1 crisis paths (the composite lost about 19% in 2008). The multi-strategy segment alone (beta 0.2, 2% idiosyncratic) ran 6% volatility and lost almost nothing on average in that stress, which made hedge funds look like a free lunch to the optimizer. The ER file still sets each world's mean return.
bucket_overrides.source: HFRI Fund Weighted Composite: beta to global equities about 0.4, 2008 loss about -19%; Getmansky, Lo and Makarov (2004) on smoothed hedge-fund returns understating volatility; Jurek and Stafford (2015) on hedge funds' put-writing-like risk

families.unit: rate of contribution by fund year (then the last rate), fund life L in years, bow factor B, minimum distribution yield Y
families.rationale: The benchmark: the Takahashi-Alexander model's contribution, distribution and NAV recursions with typical practitioner settings by strategy (closed-end funds call 25% / 33% / 50% of the remaining commitment; equity funds distribute on a bow of 2.5 over a 12-year life; credit and real assets pay a yield). Growth G is each bucket's ER base return, the same expected return the engine uses, so the comparison isolates what the deterministic model leaves out.
families.source: Takahashi and Alexander (2002), Illiquid Alternative Asset Fund Modeling, Journal of Portfolio Management; parameters are assumptions to calibrate

quality_passthrough.rationale: Secondary buyers price half of a holding's credible under- or out-performance against its vintage peers to persist over its remaining duration (capped at 4 years), so underperformers trade at deeper discounts.

rho_extra.unit: bid per $ of NAV by state [BEN, DRT, STR]
rho_extra.rationale: Venture LP interests trade at deeper discounts than buyout; the prototype had no venture bid key.

today_state.rationale: Today's market state for t0 bids: an exit drought (DPI falling) without a macro crisis.

clip.rationale: Bounds on a modeled secondary bid.

lp_depth_year_bn.rationale: Secondary-market depth for ADIC's LP sales (PE + Secondaries).

coinvest_sale_share.unit: share of bucket NAV a year

buy_cap_year_bn.rationale: Capacity for new secondary purchases and co-investments.

basis_vintages.rationale: Status-quo pacing = average original commitment per vintage over these years, by bucket.

mult_range.rationale: Bounds for the optimizer's pacing plan.

lev_cap.rationale: Gross exposure cap in today's drought state.

forced_sale_eps.rationale: Liquidity appetite: tolerated probability of a forced private sale.

n_lp_paths.rationale: In-sample scenarios for the LP (360 scenarios: a GBO solve takes about 15 s). Certification uses separate, larger paths.

seed_oos.rationale: Certification paths (never seen by the LP).

seed_val.rationale: Validation paths: the house guards (depth guard, forced-sale appetite) are re-checked on them after each solve and tightened if breached; never used for certification.

n_val_paths.rationale: Validation set size (1,200 paths): enough to estimate the worst-10% average within a few tenths of a point.

seed_factor_means.rationale: Factor-mean estimate used to calibrate alphas.

years.source: User: 10% over a multi-period horizon; prototype 5 years

rate.rationale: The fund's hurdle: 10% a year time-weighted, gross of owner distributions.

floor_breach_cost.rationale: LP cost of the reserve sitting below its TARGET (soft): above the cost of topping it up from liquid sales, far below a forced sale. The hard floor is never breached.

liquid_sale_cost.rationale: LP opportunity cost on liquid risk assets sold to fund needs, on top of their expected excess return.
